correctness.rationale: Exact fiber reduction yields Gram V(t)*V(t) and true optimal squared Riesz constants; irrational cube-phase constraints prove vertical transform zero-free and orthogonal incompleteness. The local inverse-function lemma holds at the two isolated nondegenerate torus zeros and is uniform by compactness. Pell arithmetic \(p^2-2q^2=2\) supplies a nonzero integer denominator for the global \(R^{-1}\) obstruction; its explicit recurrence yields uniform spacing and \(O(R^{-1})\) upper witnesses. Symbolic Hermitian matrix trace/determinant/trace-square prove first-order eigenvalues and the leading coefficient. The supplied verifier replays 9 Pell recurrence/residue cases, the exact cubic characteristic polynomial and seven high-precision Gram eigenvalue calculations; no finite calculation is treated as an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The non-spectrality implication alone is covered by qualitative factor-spectrality results and is explicitly treated as preliminary, not novel. The surviving new assertion is that this fixed nonspectral irrational three-segment measure has arbitrarily near-tight complete exponential bases with a sharp reciprocal vertical-bandwidth rate and the exact Pell subsequence coefficient. The full source most directly matching the segment geometry proves density rigidity and qualitative two-segment criteria, not that quantitative assertion. Published finite-group ratio results do not imply the continuous irrational Diophantine law. Residual inaccessible/full-text and unindexed-equivalence risk remains and independent audit is not claimed.
residual_risks: Full text of arXiv:2607.01500 was not obtained despite open-access and authorized institutional attempts; the qualitative abstract covers nonspectrality but quantitative content is not ruled out.
An unindexed or differently named near-Hadamard Diophantine construction could imply the 1/R rate or Pell coefficient.
The theorem optimizes only a specifically defined three-coset product family; it gives no unrestricted all-exponential-bases minimum.

value.rationale: The natural minimal nontrivial three-segment vertical fiber is not spectral, yet can support Riesz bases with conditioning arbitrarily close to orthonormal. The complete reciprocal vertical-bandwidth law answers how rapidly this approximation can occur in a motivated sampling architecture and shows both a forced quadratic-field obstruction and explicit constructive sharpness. The exact Pell subsequence coefficient further distinguishes quantitative stability from qualitative spectrality. This is not claimed as an arbitrary slice or a global optimization over all possible frequencies.
